rawContent: Celebrating my dear friend #OlafurEliasson tonight at his @Tate opening - the artist who helped me understand and love art. For its beauty and for what it says about #ClimateEmergency, migration and the world. See this exhibition https://t.co/k7knE8MWJF https://t.co/miZumTCm7t

Excited to see my family of brilliant women working on #ClimateEmergency profiled at #OlafurEliasson opening @Tate -
@DrKWilkinson’s remarkable work @ProjectDrawdown, @jesssearch & @finzibeadie @MothersInvent - and the wonderful Mary Robinson #ClimateJustice https://t.co/mFDjp8nZlr

Great talk on #climate litigation in Australia from @juliadehm on Gloucester Resources Limited v Minister for Planning: https://t.co/yMYYdMzVf5 opening w/ acknowledgment of traditional landowners & how we can learn from indigenous communities on climate & sustainability #PILC2019
